pdf-redaction.name: pdf-redaction
key_points: ALWAYS verify with pdftotext, not PyMuPDF — redaction may look correct in a viewer but pdftotext (used by most verifiers) extracts differently. Run `pdftotext redacted.pdf -` and grep for sensitive text.

NEVER use draw_rect or overlay rectangles for redaction — `page.draw_rect()` draws on top of text but doesn't remove it from extraction. Only `add_redact_annot()` + `apply_redactions()` actually removes text.
pdf-redaction.description: Redact text from PDFs for anonymization, blind review, or privacy — PyMuPDF search+annotate pipeline with verification.
pdf-redaction.scope: Redact text from PDFs for anonymization, blind review, or privacy — PyMuPDF search+annotate pipeline with verification.

pdf-form-filling.name: pdf-form-filling
key_points: ALWAYS use `set_field()` for form fields, not text overlays — form values have their own extraction layer; drawing text over a field doesn't change the field value in extracted text.
NEVER assume PDF text extraction matches visual layout — text is extracted by content stream order, not reading order; search for substrings, don't expect line structure.
NEVER rely on visual inspection alone — a PDF may look correct in a viewer but fail text extraction checks; always verify programmatically.
